summary: Comprehensive architectural blueprint and phased implementation plan for the Ekklesphere Creator Console (/console) and Platform Security Overhaul. Details the Phase 0 security remediation matrix (locking down session token generation, header spoofing elimination, production secret validation, and zero-trust organization scoping), the canonical organizations and fail-closed licensing schema backed by Supabase Postgres, the dual-engine nightly rollup cron, and the high-density creator UI with audited support sessions and aggregate-only telemetry.
